samples.summary: User-facing docs still list only Bold/Italic/Strikethrough/Link/Table for the notes formatting toolbar; the three new buttons (Quote, Code block, Foldout) are not added, so the shipped toolbar and the end-user documentation disagree. (The table is already missing the image button, so this is pre-existing drift, but this change widens it.)
samples.evidence: Toolbar button table at packages/documentation/notes/writing-a-note.md:49-55 vs new TooltipButtons in packages/frontend/src/app/notes/notes-toolbar.tsx:288-300

samples.summary: The container margin hardcodes the magic literal `1.1428571em` to mirror `prose-sm`'s paragraph rhythm (confirmed: `.note-preview { @apply prose prose-sm ... }` in packages/frontend/src/index.css:20). If the preview ever switches prose size, the foldout silently drifts off the vertical grid with nothing to catch it; deriving it (e.g. reusing the paragraph rule or a variable) would be more durable.
